description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

BAE Systems is a defense, aerospace, and security company developing technologies for national security. The Software Engineer will build and maintain React/TypeScript frontend interfaces, write automated tests, participate in code reviews, manage assigned work, contribute to documentation, and grow toward end-to-end feature ownership.
Frontend engineer building React/TypeScript interfaces, tests, documentation, and feature functionality

Responsibilities:
• Build and maintain React/TypeScript components and views against defined designs and requirements
• Write unit and integration tests; contribute to E2E coverage
• Participate in code review, both receiving and, increasingly, giving it
• Break down assigned work in JIRA, keep tickets current, communicate blockers early
• Contribute to technical documentation and Storybook stories
• Grow toward owning a feature area end to end

Requirements:
• BS in Computer Science, related field, or equivalent practical experience (bootcamp, self-taught with a portfolio, military technical background)
• Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript and at least one modern frontend framework (React preferred)
• Understanding of HTTP, async programming, and version control (Git)
• Evidence of building something non-trivial — coursework, internship, personal project, open source
• Clear written communication and a willingness to ask questions earl
• Ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Secret clearance (U.S. citizen)

Preferred:
• Node.js
• Familiarity with testing tools (Jest, Vitest, Playwright, Cypress)
• Exposure to CI/CD concepts
• Any experience with monorepos, gRPC/protobuf, or typed API clients
• Comfort using AI coding tools thoughtfully, as an accelerant, with judgment about the output
• Interest in UX, wireframing, or data visualization
• Internship or co-op experience in a regulated or team-based engineering environment
